remarks: Contemporary waterfront living doesn't get better than this. Designed and rebuilt in 2018 by the award winning architectural firm, Vicente Burin Architects of Fairfield, 60 Harbor View is a contemporary style home featuring stunning views of Long Island Sound, superb craftsmanship, extraordinary architectural details and remarkable millwork throughout. This light-filled home offers an open concept great room/dining area with cathedral ceiling and a wall of retractable windows to showcase the spectacular and seemingly endless views of Long Island Sound. There's a deck to take in the sunrise, moonrise, Ospreys, sailboats and so much more. Completing the living area is a chic and cutting edge kitchen with ample space, storage and pantry. Enjoy the large primary bedroom suite which also features spectacular views of Long Island Sound. There's plenty of room to include a desk or sitting area. Walk out onto the deck to drink your morning coffee or just relax and read a book. Rounding out the primary bedroom suite is a large walk-in closet and a luxurious bathroom with sunken tub, oversized shower and custom vanity. Two additional bedrooms, chic full bath, storage area and laundry room complete this level. On top of being sophisticated and stylish, 60 Harbor View was designed to be functional. It's FEMA compliant, has electric storm shutters, an automatic generator, an oversized garage, extra parking and a top-of-the-line HVAC system including radiant heat throughout.
